Sky.RequestTooLarge: The sky calculation request exceeds the allowed size.
Sky.InvalidInstant: Enter an ISO 8601 date and time with an explicit Z or UTC offset.
Sky.UnsupportedDate: This initial calculation supports 2000–2035. The entire search window must fit within this range.
Sky.InvalidElevation: Enter an elevation between -500 and 10000 metres, or leave it unknown.
Sky.UnsupportedBody: Select up to nine distinct supported Solar System bodies.
Sky.Assumptions: Apparent body-centre positions for a mathematical horizon. Unknown elevation uses 0 metres on the model's reference Earth ellipsoid. Standard refraction is a model; terrain, weather, geoid height conversion and live Earth orientation corrections are not included.
Sky.ConditionsUnknown: Weather, surrounding obstacles and practical visibility have not been evaluated.
Sky.CrossingNotFound: Not found within the search window
Sky.CrossingDefinition: The body centre crosses altitude 0° without atmospheric refraction. The window is 24 UTC hours; conventional sunrise and sunset also account for the disc edge, refraction and horizon.
Sky.AzimuthCalculated: Model direction clockwise from north; east is 90°.
Sky.PolarAzimuthUnavailable: At latitudes from 89° through 90° north or south, this initial model does not provide azimuth. Near-pole reference cases exceeded the directional accuracy target; altitude is reported separately.
